projects.name: FWA BNG (Airtel Fixed Wireless and Broadband Network)
projects.role: Coordination with upstream service providers and clients for bandwidth delivery and issues.
details: (client Bharti Airtel):
Handling Routing & Switching. Configuration end to end nodes, integrating nodes successfully
with all test cases pass & successfully participated in the deployment and integration of Nokia
FWA BNG nodes for Bharti Airtel's Fixed Wireless Access network.
• I have been part of team that have played vital role in integrating the Nokia FWA
BNG Routers & switches in one of the largest ISPs of India (Bharti Airtel).
• Working as network implementation / Migration Engineer.
• Conducting Proof of Concept (PoC) activities for new network deployments
• Configure services, like BGP, LDP, MPLS, VPRN, VPLS, OSPF on Nokia SR series routers.
• Software upgradation of Nokia Core Boxes through remote.
• Performing protocol-level debugging and log analysis for issue resolution
• Creating link aggregate LAG, LACP Active as per design.
• Preparation of migration strategy and discuss with customer.
• Part of preparing MOP’s, HLD, LLD as per configuration requirement from customer.
• Configuration of BNG (Broadband Network Gateway) with DHCP and creating subscriber interfaces.
• Acceptance test preparation and taking confirmation from customer or writing.
• Performed all the test cases like LI integration, AAA integration, Tacacs Integration, alarm testing
with NSP, PPP sessions & IPOE sessions as per the customer requirements.
• Delivering 5G network along with 4G to PPPoe & IPoE customers.
• Documenting all configuration changes and processes through change
management processes
• Joining bridge calls during connectivity issues and analyzing the issues to work with
other teams
• Configuration/ Troubleshooting of various IGP/EGP protocols (BGP, MPLS, ISIS,
L2VPN, L3VPN)
